name: first-user-ms-marvel
about: The session of the first outside user. The repository holds the user's words, the slots, the counts, and the bars (D-642). The collection stays in a private object, and this file pins its hash (D-639, D-1124).

turns.words: Build a mono-u voltron deck with a good protection suite around Ms. Marvel
There's a lot of "Artifacts matter" cards. I'd prefer to play around handsize matters, to increase Marvels' power. Also should be heavy on the cantrips

messages: Build a mono-u voltron deck with a good protection suite around Ms. Marvel
Ms. Marvel as my commander. Bracket 3.
There's a lot of "Artifacts matter" cards. I'd prefer to play around handsize matters, to increase Marvels' power. Also should be heavy on the cantrips
paid.limits: chat-probe sends text alone. It sends no option index and no pool rule, so turns 2 to 4 are typed answers and the pool rule comes from the classifier. It prints the last deck alone, with no card list and no grade, so the deck measures of step 1 and the kept count of step 2 need a manual read.
